import unreal
lib=unreal.EditorAssetLibrary
D='/Game/P4/Meshy'
new=lib.load_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy_PhysicsAsset')
old=D+'/PA_P4_Meshy'
if new:
    if lib.does_asset_exist(old): print('A28 Meshy pa delete_empty', lib.delete_asset(old))
    print('A28 Meshy pa rename', lib.rename_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy_PhysicsAsset', old))
pa=lib.load_asset(old)
mesh=lib.load_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy')
mesh.set_editor_property('physics_asset', pa)
lib.save_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy', only_if_is_dirty=False); lib.save_asset(old, only_if_is_dirty=False)
bodies=[str(b.bone_name) for b in pa.get_editor_property('skeletal_body_setups')]
print('A28 Meshy pa bodies', len(bodies), ' '.join(bodies))
